name: cavuno
description: Cavuno workflows for running a job board: post and import jobs, manage employers, set up pricing, write and refresh blog posts, and review performance through the hosted Cavuno MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Run your Cavuno job board from ChatGPT and Codex
interface.longDescription: Cavuno helps associations, publications, communities and standalone businesses launch, run and grow a job board with AI. These skills connect to Cavuno's hosted MCP to post and import jobs, manage employers, set up pricing, draft job digests, write and refresh blog posts, and report on performance, confirming every change first.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my Cavuno board and tell me what needs attention this week
